raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Follow-up to #62783, which was merged before I could add the test case requested in [review](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62783#discussion_r4344897617). With an explicit `truncation_side`, `get_encode_kwargs` disables tokenizer truncation, so the cut happens in `apply_post_tokenization`. If the JinaVL score token were appended before that step (in `get_score_prompt`), right-side truncation would drop it again. This adds a `truncation_side="right"` case to `test_truncation_keeps_jinavl_score_token`.

## Claims

- The JinaVL score token test now covers an explicit right truncation side, which is the case that breaks if `post_process_tokens` moves back before `apply_post_tokenization`.
- Test-only change.

## Validation

- `pytest tests/entrypoints/pooling/scoring/test_io_processor_unit.py`: 17 passed on current `main`.
- With `post_process_tokens` moved back into `get_score_prompt` (reserved limits applied only to tokenization), the new `[4-32-right]` case fails and the existing cases still pass, so the new case is the one that catches this.
- `pre-commit run --files <changed files>`: all hooks pass.

## Details

Not a duplicate: this only extends the test added in #62783.

AI assistance was used to write the test and run the validation shown above.

files.patch:
@@ -134,12 +134,17 @@ def test_offline_scoring_uses_default_template_unless_overridden(
     assert prompt["prompt_token_ids"] == processor.tokenizer.encode(expected)
 
 
-@pytest.mark.parametrize("truncate_prompt_tokens,max_total_tokens", [(4, 32), (-1, 8)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "truncate_prompt_tokens,max_total_tokens,truncation_side",
+    [(4, 32, None), (-1, 8, None), (4, 32, "right")],
+)
 def test_truncation_keeps_jinavl_score_token(
-    llm_reranker_processor, truncate_prompt_tokens, max_total_tokens
+    llm_reranker_processor, truncate_prompt_tokens, max_total_tokens, truncation_side
 ):
     """JinaVL scores the token it appends to the prompt, so binding
-    truncation must keep it within the requested length."""
+    truncation must keep it within the requested length. An explicit
+    truncation side skips tokenizer truncation and cuts in
+    apply_post_tokenization instead."""
     processor = llm_reranker_processor
     processor.supports_score_template = True
     processor.model = JinaVLForSequenceClassification
@@ -155,6 +160,7 @@ def test_truncation_keeps_jinavl_score_token(
             tok_params=TokenizeParams(
                 max_total_tokens=max_total_tokens,
                 truncate_prompt_tokens=truncate_prompt_tokens,
+                truncation_side=truncation_side,
             ),
             prompt_extras=None,
             skip_mm_cache=False,
